claims.claim: The API base path is /GovServiceList/IDRServer/ and all calls are POST with Content-Type application/json.

A live SearchByName for acamol on 2026-08-27 returned registration 020 16 20534 00, ACAMOL, paracetamol 500 mg, holder TEVA ISRAEL LTD, not prescription-only, in the health basket, regulated consumer price 14.12 NIS.

Basket and prescription status are properties of a registration number, not of a brand: LOSEC 20 MG returns health false and prescription false while LOSEC 20 MG RX returns health true and prescription true.

GetSpecificDrug returns per-indication basket entitlement, not just a boolean. Keytruda (154 38 34448 00) returns 101 salList entries plus frameworkOfInclusion conditions and a specialist-only limitations string.

claims.claim: The list of drugs in the health basket is a closed list, set out in the National Health Insurance order, and updated once a year.

claims.claim: Chronic patients have a quarterly payment ceiling above which basket drugs are supplied without further charge. As of May 2026 Clalit is 1,190 NIS per quarter and Maccabi 1,137 NIS per quarter.

Copay is a banded percentage with a floor, not a fixed amount per package. Leumit charges the consumer price up to 20.80 NIS, then 20.80 up to 156.30, then 15% above that where no generic exists; where a generic exists it charges 10% of the price or 20.80, whichever is higher.
